status: V3T1 evidence captured; V3T2 development proposal, not predictive acceptance

source_scope.all_group_inventory: 15 source schemas and row counts; includes no target schema or target values
source_scope.financial_completeness: 1078 companies in 200 train/validation groups; all 50 v1 final_test groups excluded
source_scope.global_fx_exception: Existing aggregate FX evidence mart only: 24 EUR identity rates, 405 non-EUR currency-months with no applicable rate; no outcome analysis
source_scope.read_operations: 22 bounded aggregate queries plus 15 schema-only LIMIT 0 queries and 15 count-only queries; DuckDB 1.5.5 in memory; no spill, data writes, pipelines or models

findings.facts: 4130 cash products; 3516 have booked closed-month activity, only 472 have activity in all 24 months; 2694 first appear after September 2024, 1139 last appear before August 2026, and 614 have no observed booked activity in the closed period.
findings.monthly_endpoints: September 2024: 376 companies, 822 products, 31815 rows; August 2026: 966 companies, 2377 products, 116470 rows. Full monthly counts and internal-gap distribution are in audit.json.
findings.consequence: Do not equate 24 calendar slots or a current balance with 24 months of complete ledgers. Activity gaps may be inactivity or missing feeds; neither zero nor interpolation is justified. Even all-24 activity is not a completeness attestation.

findings.facts: 3972 of 4130 cash products have anchors; 3967 are finite after cleaning, 3204 are EUR; 472 have both a finite anchor and all-24 activity. Every development product with a balance has only one snapshot. All 3972 cash anchors lack available balances; date fields are midnight and do not say opening versus closing.
findings.timing: Checking anchors range August 28 to September 1, 2026; 7102 booked cash transactions on anchor calendar days affect 1296 products. Those open-period movements matter for anchor bridging even though September is not a scored closed month.
findings.consequence: No independently reconciled or unrestricted cash history can currently be certified. Subtracting EUR transaction sums from a converted snapshot is not a valid FX reconciliation. Future-anchor provenance must prevent earlier as-of use.

findings.facts: All-group inventory: 2239 debt products and 87 schedule configurations. Development: 1914 debt products in 330 companies; 76 schedules in 33 companies, 66 settlement accounts found in the same company/currency, 62 with observed closed-month cash activity. Only 335 debt products have any ledger rows. 645 have reported zero snapshot outstanding, 1152 have negative raw outstanding.
findings.consequence: Snapshot sign convention, zero outstanding and absence of transactions do not establish debt absence or historical balances. Latest rates and next/last dates cannot recreate historical schedules. Settlement-account existence is not payment allocation. Existing panel_deuda measures identified paid service, not complete obligations due or outstanding debt.

findings.facts: 788477 development documents in 679 companies; 20201 missing/invalid due dates, 88814 missing EUR amounts, 561742 terminal settlement dates, 208209 non-paid documents with payment_date that is not actual settlement, 6158 possible partial-payment snapshots, 282 paid-with-pending contradictions. Invoice-only signs: 397588 negative, 267168 positive, 780 zero/null.
findings.consequence: Positive/negative AP/AR assignment is a legacy sign proxy, not an explicit verified role field. A final paid date is not a history of partial payments. No obligation/payment allocation key, dated cancellation/renegotiation log, historical import time or completeness attestation is present. Credit/refund/group/payment documents must not be double counted as invoices.

findings.facts: Of 25872 development company-months, 17893 have cash activity, 16478 a known cash net, 6112 fully identified operating receipts, 4470 fully identified operating payments, 2892 a fully identified operating net; 14973 have classification ambiguity and 1415 missing EUR. Only 1584 company-months have six contiguous known-receipt months; 243 have fifteen.
findings.consequence: Known-receipt history is only a necessary condition for comparable growth, not verification of sales or company completeness. Financing, transfers, asset disposals, unknown categories, changing account perimeter and payment retention cannot become growth. Manual simulator growth_pct is not a source.

findings.facts: Development transaction dates span September 1, 2024 to September 1, 2026 22:59:35; 7946 open-month rows; booking and value timestamps differ in 288145 rows. All booking/value timestamps and nominal amounts are syntactically usable, and transaction/invoice IDs have no counted duplicates/nulls.
findings.consequence: Syntactic validity is not economic correctness or historical availability. created_at is onboarding/connection, date is booking, value_date is bank value date; none is immutable known_on. Existing mart available_at is a construction rule, not historical ingestion evidence.

headline_score_gate.meaning: Eligibility conclusion under the proposed strict contract, not a computed score distribution or new model evaluation
headline_score_gate.policy: Publish known subtotals/dimensions only with explicit scope; headline score null. Missing evidence must not improve health and must not be treated as economic distress either.

future_evaluation_blocker.v1: All 50 final_test groups permanently excluded from v3 development, event creation, case selection and confirmatory evaluation. Existing evaluation receipt preserved, not reopened.
future_evaluation_blocker.v2: reserved-access.json consumed=true. March-May 2026 origins and outcomes through August 2026 were already evaluated. Changing targets or partition names does not create independence.
future_evaluation_blocker.required: New future dates or external cohorts with a documented access ledger and availability vintages, sealed before outcomes are inspected. Prefer external unseen groups; future dates on known non-final_test groups test temporal transport only.
future_evaluation_blocker.permitted_next: Generic financial methods, invented fixtures, and explicitly retrospective/development-only exploration of existing 200 groups. No confirmatory run, new old-reserve labels, tuning on v2 reserve, or claim that all six questions are answered.

requested_new_evidence: Complete account/product universe with effective opening/closure dates and currency histories; statement coverage attestations including genuine zero-activity intervals.
Opening/closing anchor semantics, timezone, immutable available_at, unrestricted/blocked amounts, at least two independent balance observations per reconciliation span and documented adjustments.
Native-currency movement ledger and month-end/anchor FX valuations with availability; no estimated cross-currency balancing plug.
Versioned financial-debt principal roll-forwards, drawdowns, installment due amounts, interest components/rates and dated amendments; explicit zero-debt attestations where applicable.
AP/AR role verification, unique obligations, complete due-date cohorts, partial-payment allocations, cancellation/renegotiation/reversal events and their known_on times.
Independent future economic follow-up and blinded financial reference judgments on untouched data; no official-rating or bankruptcy claim.
